package.author: tenequm
package.description: Lossless storage and search for sessions from any AI agent client

en-US.author: tenequm
en-US.description: Lossless storage and search for sessions from any AI agent client
en-US.longDescription: pond ingests agent sessions from Claude Code, Codex, opencode and other clients into storage you own, makes the whole corpus searchable and SQL-queryable, and serves it back to agents over MCP.
en-US.name: pond
en-US.releaseNotes:
🐛 Bug Fixes
- claude-code: classify fallback blocks as injected and document blocks as files (#364) (67592c3)
  pond now stores Claude Code model-fallback markers as harness content,
  so they no longer show up as assistant text in search, stores PDF
  attachments as files, and records the media type of PDF and image
  attachments. Sessions ingested earlier keep the old classification.
